mentions.name: AmmoSight
mentions.description: This web app tracks ammo prices from various US e-commerce merchants with shipping costs included, and tracks price trends and historical prices. It includes tools for enthusiasts to calculate trajectories, recoil, and compare calibers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a web app that tracks ammo prices from various US ecomm merchants with the shipping costs included. It also tracks price trends and historical prices. Added some tools for enthusiasts to calculate trajectories, recoil, and compare calibers.
